# @rytass/erp-oracle-fusion-nestjs

NestJS module for `@rytass/erp-oracle-fusion` (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP REST client and FBDI toolkit).

## Package Overview

Wires the framework-agnostic Fusion client into NestJS dependency injection. Configuration comes
from any provider (ConfigService, Vault, literal values); the observability sink is bound through DI;
the NestJS `Logger` is bridged into the client automatically.

All client behaviour (REST calls, retry policy, error semantics, FBDI template engine, ESS jobs)
lives in the core package — see its `llms.txt`. This package only covers module assembly.

## Features

### Module Registration
- `FusionClientModule.forRoot({ config, isGlobal?, callLogSink?, disableLogger? })`
- `FusionClientModule.forRootAsync({ imports, inject, useFactory, ... })` — config resolved from
  any injectable provider
- Provides `FusionRestClient` and `FusionFbdiService`
- Exports `FUSION_CLIENT_OPTIONS` and `FUSION_CALL_LOG_SINK` DI tokens

### Observability Sink Binding
- `callLogSink: { useExisting }` — reuse a provider exported by another module
- `callLogSink: { useClass }` — let this module instantiate it
- `callLogSink: { useFactory, inject }` — factory binding
- Defaults to `NoopFusionCallLogSink` when omitted, so the module works with no observability setup

### Logger Bridging
NestJS `Logger` is adapted to the core `FusionLogger` interface automatically; pass
`disableLogger: true` to silence the client entirely.

## Critical Constraints

- **`forRoot(Async)` must be called exactly once.** Calling it twice creates two clients with
  independent OAuth token caches. To share across modules, wrap it in one module that does
  `exports: [FusionClientModule]` and have consumers import that wrapper.
- **The sink's module must not depend on `FusionRestClient`.** The module needs the sink at startup,
  so a sink module that also consumes the client forms a module cycle. Keep the sink in a small
  module that depends only on its own storage layer.
- Prefer the wrapper-module topology over `isGlobal: true`: dependencies stay visible in module
  definitions and tests can assemble only what they need.

## Requirements

- `@nestjs/common` >= 10 (peer)
- `@rytass/erp-oracle-fusion` (dependency)
